name: A.I-Mnemosyne Jiyi Nushen
source:
The background of the story takes place in 2030, the world of rapid technological advancement in the unknown world line ──
Mankind has reached its peak in all aspects of scientific and technological research, but because of excessive development and research, it has planted the seeds of crisis...
translation:
故事发生在2030年，在一条未知的世界线上，科技正飞速发展——
人类在各个领域的科技研究都已达到巅峰，却也因过度开发与研究，埋下了危机的种子……
